subject: general
question: Which cricket team reached their historic milestone to become the first team to play 1000 One Day International (ODI) Matches in the month of Feb 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India played their first ODI match on 13th July 1974.
 
• The first ODI match in India was held at the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Stadium, Ahmedabad in 1981.
 
• Kapil Dev is the first Indian player to score a century in one day international.
 
• Lala Amarnath was the first Indian player to score a century in test cricket.
 
• India won its first one-day international world cup in 1983.
 
 
• It was under the captaincy of Kapil Dev by defeating West Indies.
 
 
 
• India won its second one-day international world cup in 2011.
 
 
• It was under the captaincy of MS Dhoni by defeating Sri Lanka.
